definitions.explanation: Describes something that inspires awe through its grandeur, dignity, or sacred quality. Used for religious settings, grand ceremonies, natural landscapes, and architecture.

examples.japanese: {荘厳|そうごん}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: I was enveloped in a solemn atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大聖堂|だいせいどう}→大聖堂：20731_daiseidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{荘厳|そうごん}な{美|うつく}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちていた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧。
examples.english: The interior of the cathedral was filled with sublime beauty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頂|いただき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{朝日|あさひ}→朝日：23495_asahi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{荘厳|そうごん}で、⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: The sunrise seen from the mountaintop was so majestic that I involuntarily held my breath.

notes:
USAGE: {荘厳|そうごん} is a na-adjective used in literary and formal contexts. It describes an elevated, awe-inspiring quality that goes beyond mere beauty. It is often used for religious architecture, sacred rituals, and grand natural scenery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荘厳|そうごん}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧ (solemn atmosphere)
- {荘厳|そうごん}な⟦{儀式|ぎしき}→儀式：00071_gishiki⟧ (solemn ceremony)
- {荘厳|そうごん}な⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧ (majestic music)
- {荘厳|そうごん}な⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧ (sublime architecture)

SIMILAR WORDS: Compare with ⟦{厳粛|げんしゅく}→厳粛：14755_genshuku⟧ (grave, solemn), which emphasizes seriousness and gravity, while {荘厳|そうごん} emphasizes grandeur and sublimity. {荘厳|そうごん} often implies visual or spatial impressiveness, whereas ⟦{厳粛|げんしゅく}→厳粛：14755_genshuku⟧ focuses on a serious, reverent mood.
